summary: Validated CRM Company tab gating + relabel on AlphaCo (Site A) using owner@isodemo.com. Backend GET /api/svc/cases/qa-case-rev/crm-context returns the correct linked=true payload for the same user. However, the Service Desk reverse-view UI could NOT be validated end-to-end because owner@isodemo.com cannot reach /service-desk: the frontend capability gate `view_service_desk` in src/utils/capabilities.js (line 39-40) requires user.is_service_desk OR user.is_master_admin OR isPulseAdmin; iso-owner has all three flags = false (role='owner'), so AppRoutes.js line 486 redirects /service-desk → /login → /dashboard.

integration_issues.evidence: POST /api/auth/login → user.is_service_desk=false, is_master_admin=false, role='owner'. Navigating to /service-desk lands on /dashboard. capabilities.js:39 `view_service_desk = !!(user?.is_service_desk || user?.is_master_admin) || isPulseAdmin(user)` does NOT grant by role=owner.

blocker_root_cause: Either (a) the seed for iso-owner needs `is_service_desk: true` (preferred since iso-demo-org has Service Desk data seeded — case qa-case-rev, engineer qa-eng-1, PPM qa-ppm-1, contract CT-5001), or (b) the `view_service_desk` capability must also grant managerial role (owner/manager of an org whose account_type='full' includes service ops). Without one of these, the new reverse-view UI is unreachable for the credentials in this review_request.
test_credentials: owner@isodemo.com / IsoDemo123! (platform). CRM requires a second login (same creds, separate token).
critical_code_review_comments: capabilities.js `view_service_desk` is too narrow: org owners of an iso-demo-org-style tenant (which clearly runs the desk: has cases, engineers, PPMs) are blocked. Recommend grant for managerial-of-service-org (e.g., user.role in ['owner','manager'] AND org.has_service_ops).

AppRoutes.js:486 redirects unauthorized users to /login even when already authenticated, causing a confusing /login → /dashboard hop. Prefer Navigate to '/dashboard' (or a 403 page) for capability-gated routes when user is authed.
ServiceCaseDrawer.js CrmContextCard correctly fetches with `auth()` headers and gracefully renders `drawer-crm-context-unlinked` when linked=false — good defensive UX.
CRMCompanies.js line 1189 cleanly conditionalises the service tab on `company.has_service_ops` (matches spec). Cases→Support Cases relabel applied on line 1184.
